# Scurret
Scurrets are a species hailing from "Planet Wawa". Usually, scurrets are shipped onboard as temps via an order from Cargo, but some scurrets end up useful enough to earn themselves a full-time job on board. Being quite small, scurrets don't have much space to carry anything, usually only able to carry one or two things in their hands at a time. However, given their intelligence, their body has a high demand for nutrients, requiring a higher than average amount of food. They seem to come in all manner of shapes, sizes, and kinds, with some having exotic features rarely seen among other species. Perhaps this is a case of evolution going haywire?
## Racial Features - You can deal [color=red]10[/color] Piercing damage with your sharp teeth! - You need to eat and drink a lot more than other crew members. - You only have one hand slot, and one pocket. Item management is a chore, and essentially impossible without some form of backpack. - You're much more fragile, being easily put in critical condition. - Due to your small body, you can easily overheat and freeze. - You are very, very fast, able to outrun most threats.
## Scurret Sign
All scurrets (employed by NT) end up learning their own species' dialect of sign language. Being distinct from galactic sign language, it's a much more complex language to master, and many spend their entire youths with misconceptions about its basic structure. When used well, however, it is quite powerful.
## Age Being in the middle of the food chain on their home planet, they don't have much time to grow up, and so evolution has pushed them to grow up fast, and pass just as quickly. Scurrets are mature at around 8 or 9 years old, and rarely live past 40 - though lone scurrets in the wild don't tend to live past 20.
## Names Scurrets have a simple, yet poetic naming scheme, of the form of "(Adjective) (Noun)", with no extra quantifiers. They end up naming themselves, usually, around their 3rd or 4th birthday. Given this, their names usually don't have very complex or technological words in them. Alternatively, some scurrets decide on dropping the adjective entirely, naming themselves entirely after something they enjoy.
